timestampContract.acceptedShape: Strict ISO-8601 timestamp with seconds, optional 1-7 fractional-second digits, and an explicit Z or numeric offset

requiredKnownAnswers: equivalent explicit offsets normalize to the same UTC ticks
one-tick and one-second differences fail closed
same wall-clock text with a different offset fails closed
invalid, missing, empty, timezone-free, excessive-fraction and invalid-offset values fail closed
a deliberately non-unique parser-format set fails closed
both original input texts are retained in every comparison receipt
preservedRequirements: trusted launch identity rule v1 is unchanged
path and NTFS file-identity requirements are unchanged
PE and Authenticode requirements are unchanged
process composite identity requirements are unchanged
terminalRule: Freeze a PASS receipt and new status only when every offline known-answer, preservation check, source binding and boundary assertion passes. Otherwise freeze failure evidence and fail closed without retry or scope expansion.
